citation: Dollard, John J., Jr. Experimental reintroduction of state-endangered beach pea (Lathyrus japonicus) to Indiana Dunes National Lakeshore. Park Science 34, no. 1 (2018): 47-53. National Park Service.
author: John J. Dollard, Jr.
rights_note: A work of the United States government.
access_notes: Retrieved and read on 2026-08-10: beach pea 'is an early successional plant that grows commonly on the foredune nearest the lake or ocean', with marram grass and Pitcher's thistle as its associates in undisturbed Great Lakes reference populations.
note: Narrow but retrievable: it corroborates the beach-pea, marram and Pitcher's thistle association on the southern Lake Michigan foredune, which is the part of the lakeshore zone that would otherwise rest entirely on an unretrieved abstract.
what_it_does_not_supply: historical vegetation; it is a 2010s restoration study, and nothing in it attests the 1835 Chicago lakefront
